From my notes (message 3328), I told the owner Penpot has these caveats, and I did not act on it because it's his call:

1. No iPad/Pencil support, which breaks PRD D24–D27.
2. It can't be embedded (issue #11735).
3. Its MCP needs a browser tab plus a plugin.

Earlier research (message 3264) found Penpot is self-hostable, with MCP on port 4401. I only have these as summarized in my notes.
